steps.what: List technical activities already logged on the architecture project.
Manage coordination and overall integration of the engineering work.
Record integration across the engineering projects.

tasks.design: Technical activities already logged are listed from {PROJECT}. The manager coordinates them and judges the overall integration of the architecture or engineering work. An activity with no id is not listed. The list does not integrate the project.
tasks.previous_blocker: Activities lived in separate logs, and the clash showed up on site.
tasks.enabler_now: An activity already logged can be listed before the coordination meeting.
tasks.still_hard: Two logged activities that still cannot share a site, which the manager has to unwind.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can see two green activities that will still collide.
tasks.altitude: Logged activities can be listed. The manager still coordinates them and still decides the integration.

reach.task: Read the logged activities, and still leave the integration judgement here.
reach.learn: The list can be shared. The coordination stays here.

evidence.claim: A technical activity already logged on the project can be listed. The list cannot manage the coordination or the integration.
The manager decides how the activities fit. A log does not authorise a change on site.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.
Fields: Activity id, produced by the project log. An activity with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the project log the firm already keeps.
unknowns: Which clashes are only visible on site.
research_questions: What share of coordination starts from a logged activity?
Which clashes have no log line?

already_counted.description: The manager still integrates the work.
The manager still records the integration.

incremental.description: The manager logs an activity the register did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing technical activities already logged. It disappears when the activity is missing and the manager logs it. Coordinating and integrating the work stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List design change requests already stored for the project.
Direct, review, and approve project design changes.
File the accepted design change on the project record.

tasks.design: Design change requests already stored are listed from {PROJECT}. The manager directs, reviews, and approves them. The accepted change is filed in {DOCS} only for that version. A request with no drawing id is not listed. The list does not approve the change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Change requests arrived by mail and were approved in the margin of a drawing that then could not be found.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored request can be listed before the manager reviews the drawing.
tasks.still_hard: A change that is complete on paper and still unsafe on the building.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can refuse a change the checklist calls complete.
tasks.altitude: Stored requests can be listed. The manager still approves the design change, and only that version is filed.

reach.task: File a design change only after the manager has accepted that version.
reach.learn: The request can be listed. The approval stays here.

evidence.claim: A design change request already stored can be listed. The list cannot direct, review, or approve the change.
The change is filed only for the version the manager accepted. A later edit is not the accepted version.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.

Fields: Change id and drawing id, produced by the request register. A request with no drawing id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: File into the project record the firm already keeps. Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering manager.
unknowns: Which change requests are already stored.
Who else must sign a change that affects structure.
research_questions: What share of approvals start from a stored request?
Which changes are still marked on a drawing?

already_counted.description: The manager still approves the design change.

incremental.description: The manager reconstructs a request the register did not hold.

approvals.approved_version: change version and the drawing ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing design change requests already stored, and filing only the accepted version. It disappears when the request is missing and the manager reconstructs it. Approving the design stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show stored project specifications for the named clients.
Consult or negotiate with the client on those specifications.
Prepare the specification note both sides accept.

tasks.design: Project specifications already stored for the client are shown from {PROJECT}. The manager consults or negotiates them. A client with no specification id is not shown a sheet. The sheet does not close the negotiation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The last specification was read out from memory at the start of the client meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored specification can be on the table before the negotiation.
tasks.still_hard: A client who wants a performance the stored specification cannot carry.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can hear a request that would break the structure and say so in the room.
tasks.altitude: Stored specifications can be shown. The manager still negotiates them and still prepares the note both sides accept.

reach.role: Property, Real Estate, and Community Association Managers
reach.task: Bring the stored specification, and still leave the client negotiation here.
reach.learn: The sheet can be shared. The negotiation stays here.

evidence.claim: A project specification already stored for a client can be shown. The sheet cannot consult or negotiate.
The specification is what both sides accept in the meeting. The sheet does not bind the client.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.

Fields: Client id and specification id, produced by the project file. A client with no specification id is not shown a sheet. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the project file the firm already keeps. Do not send a specification from the sheet.
unknowns: Which clients already have a stored specification.
Which points must be negotiated in person.
research_questions: What share of meetings start from a stored specification?
Which specifications are written in the meeting?

already_counted.description: The manager still negotiates with the client.
The manager still prepares the accepted note.

incremental.description: The manager writes a specification the file did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is showing project specifications already stored for the client. It disappears when the specification is missing and the manager writes it. Negotiating with the client stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare budgets from the stored rates and quantities.
Review bids and contracts before they are issued.
Issue the accepted contract to the client.

tasks.design: Budgets are prepared in the {ERP} only when the rate and the quantity are both stored. The manager reviews the bid and the contract. The contract is issued by {EMAIL} only for the accepted version. A missing rate stops the line. The arithmetic does not issue the contract.
tasks.previous_blocker: Budgets were rebuilt from rate cards before each bid, and the contract sometimes carried the previous total.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored rate and quantity can be extended before the manager reviews the bid.
tasks.still_hard: A rate that is stored and still wrong for this site, which the manager has to catch.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can see a total that ties and a scope that does not.
tasks.altitude: Stored rates can be extended into a budget. The manager still reviews the bid, and the contract is issued only for the accepted version.

reach.task: Extend a stored rate into a budget, and still have a person accept it before issue.
reach.learn: The arithmetic can be shared. The acceptance stays here.

evidence.claim: A budget line can be prepared when the rate and the quantity are already stored. The arithmetic cannot review the bid or issue the contract.
The contract is issued only for the version the manager accepted. A changed figure is not that version.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.
Fields: Rate id and quantity, produced by the rate book. A line with no rate is not prepared. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Issue only through the mail the firm already uses. Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering manager.
unknowns: Which rates are current for this site.
Who else must sign before a contract is issued.
research_questions: What share of budget lines have a stored rate?
Which bids are priced in the review?

already_counted.description: The manager still reviews the bid and the contract.

incremental.description: The manager prices a line the rate book did not hold.

approvals.approved_version: budget version and the rate ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is preparing budget lines from stored rates and quantities, and issuing only the accepted contract. It disappears when the rate is missing and the manager prices the line. Reviewing the bid stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager still integrates the technical work, still approves a design change, and still negotiates the specification. A logged activity or a stored rate can be listed first, and a contract goes out only for the accepted version.
reach: Construction managers file a change only after a person accepts the drawing, and this job learns the same gate.
Compliance managers keep a rate table as arithmetic, and this job learns the arithmetic does not issue the contract.
skills_to_grow: Approve a design change before it is filed.
Negotiate the specification with the client.
role.ambitious_version: Logged activities and stored rates are ready before the manager looks at them, and design approval, negotiation, and the contract issue stay with that person.
